weather_notes: light levels shift between overcast and sunset

entries_before.text: I stayed late finishing an assignment and woke up tired. The week felt crowded with unfinished tasks.
I put off going to the library because I needed more time to finish my work.

entries_after.text: The exam was over. I was still tired, but the next steps felt manageable.
I walked home after class and noticed the cooler air. The afternoon felt unhurried.
